items.title: Should You Buy Amazon Stock For The Demand AWS Cannot Yet Serve?
items.summary: Amazon.com (AMZN) stock has returned 8.9% over the past twelve months and trades about 13% below its 52-week high. Its cloud arm spent those months doing something the share price has not reflected. AWS growth sped up again in Q2 2026, and the contracts queued up behind it kept building. The upside case for the stock rests almost entirely on turning that queue into revenue.

items.title: What Does Visa (V) Risk From Merchant Pushback And Rival Payment Rails?
items.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) faces pushback as Walmart and other large U.S. retailers oppose a proposed credit card fee settlement in 2026. Britain’s biggest banks are advancing funding for a new payments infrastructure that could compete directly with Visa’s card network in the UK. Merchant opposition and the UK bank-backed payment rails project are reshaping how Visa’s card model is being challenged on fees and competition.
